# SmartML — AI-Powered AutoML Dashboard

SmartML is an AI-powered AutoML dashboard. Upload a dataset and get automated
inspection, cleaning, model training, clustering, anomaly detection,
visualizations, and export.

## Features
- Predict mode: automatic model training and comparison (classification and regression)
- Explore mode: unsupervised clustering (K-Means, PCA, Agglomerative, Gaussian Mixture)
- Detect mode: anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, Local Outlier Factor)
- Data quality inspection and cleaning
- AI assistant chat with dataset context
- Exportable models, predictions, and reports

## Live app
- URL: https://smartml-three.vercel.app
